Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-981334

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you have questioned the original creditor, last amount paid, and the year of the last payment made.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with accurate and complete information about the debt. We have reviewed the account records and can confirm that the original creditor is Lakeshore Utilities. Unfortunately, our records do not indicate any payments made on this account. We also do not have a charge-off date prior to 2023-03-01, as indicated in our records.

We will investigate this matter further to ensure the accuracy of the information provided. We will also review our previous communications to ensure compliance with the FDCPA. As required by Florida law, we will provide you with a written validation of the debt if you request it.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe the information provided is inaccurate. If you wish to dispute the debt, please provide us with specific details of the alleged error.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]
